proposal:
STATUS: nothing executed; every number is a hand derivation from the supplied text. No polynomial-SAT claim.

A. AUDIT (new points only). (1) _verify_certificate builds blocks from every dense clause, confines each used form to its block mask and checks P*L=I entrywise, giving F(x)=Q(Px) with P onto. Reading found no soundness defect; that is not a proof of the Python. (2) The metered bit cost is the sum over blocks of 2^|S|*(clause literals+quotient literals+form bits) plus r^2*n. The last test runs after the matrix loop, which is harmless. (3) Every skip returns the original input; probe is UNSAT-only behind the subset gate. (4) prune compares states with different eliminated or merged variables. This is sound, because below(g,h) is clause-level implication between formulas each equisatisfiable with its own branch.

B. MECHANISM: COFACTOR-CLASS CELLS (CELL). For a variable cell C let F_C be the clauses meeting C. For c in {0,1}^C let F_C|c be the raw clause set after deleting satisfied clauses and false literals (no UP). c is dead if the empty clause appears. mu(C) is the number of distinct live sets R_1..R_mu.
Rule CELL-m: if mu<=2^m with m<|C|, add m fresh variables y, give class r the code e_r, and replace F_C by Q_C = K + {not[y=e_r] or D : D in R_r minus K} + {not[y=e] : e unused}, where K is the intersection of the R_r. Accept only if clause and literal counts do not increase.
Lemma CELL (claimed): F_C(c,z)=Q_C(code(class c),z) for live c, F_C(c,z)=0 for dead c, and every used code has a live preimage. So the two formulas are equisatisfiable, models lift through a table of at most 2^m preimages, and the rule can decide SAT as well as UNSAT.
Certificate: the class map plus Q_C. The checker recomputes the 2^|C| restrictions and compares clause sets syntactically, costing 2^|C|*||F_C|| literal visits plus sorting, with no enumeration of outside variables. This is the nonlinear sibling of the Lean-checked local block rule: a section table replaces the right inverse.
Lemma CONG (claimed): classes are a congruence. class(c1,c2) depends only on (class c1, class c2), so mu(C1 u C2)<=mu(C1)*mu(C2), computable from representatives.
Lemma E (extras, claimed): a clause has exactly two outcomes across a cut (satisfied, or its outside part), so mu_{F+E}(C)<=mu_F(C)*2^e, where e counts extras meeting C. Arbitrary extras cost work, never correctness; e=O(log||F||) stays polynomial.

C. INVARIANT. For a binary tree T with the variables as leaves, bmw(F,T) is the largest node mu. Theorem TREE (claimed, via CONG): given T, satisfiability is decided with at most (n-1)*mu^2 restrictions, O(n*mu^2*||F||*log||F||*log n) bit operations, and mu*||F|| memory per node. The procedure is total on every CNF. A fixed branching order is the caterpillar case. On Neon58 the ascending quotient order is a bad caterpillar (prefixes hold one member of each pair, about 2^t classes); the pair-adjacent order is a good one (mu=2, consistent with the trusted peak 2). Greedy agglomeration (merge the two current cells of least mu, cap B, otherwise stop and hand the partly contracted formula to v5) needs at most n^3*B^2 restrictions of cost ||F|| each. That bounds preprocessing unconditionally, with no completeness claim.

D. NEON58 HAND TRACE. In the quotient each twin pair has classes {00} and {10,01,11}: mu=2, gate OR. Non-twin pairs have mu=4; a left pair-cell merged with a right pair-cell has 3 live classes. Eight contractions take 48 clauses to 18 on 8 variables (the fixture, Q18). Reading the 20-variable clauses directly gives the same with 3-cells and mixed gates: g1=x1|x9, g2=x3|x11, g3=x5|(x13^x14), g4=x7|(x17^x18), g5=x2|x10, g6=x4|x12, g7=x6|(x15^x16), g8=x8|(x19^x20), and F=Q18(g). So CELL-3 does not need the linear compressor here. Independent test: compare over all 2^20 points, or locally over 2*1024+16*64 points. Work: 120 pair candidates * 4 restrictions * 80 literals per round, at most 8 rounds, under 4*10^5 literal visits.
Fixture prediction on pinned v5: compression skipped (all_variables_in_odd_blocks); core no_clauses_removed; root IALH meets an empty table at window [1,2,3,4] after 65 windows and 464 tuples; UNSAT, peak 0. If IALH did not fire, size-nonincreasing DP still closes at the root, so peak 0 is robust.

E. KERNEL-FREE TEST. Replace each variable of any CNF Q by MAJ(x,y,z) on fresh variables. Every pair inside a gate has mu=3 (classes 00, 11, mixed), so pair-twin contraction cannot fire; the 3-cell has mu=2. Prediction for an independent implementation: CELL-3 returns Q up to renaming, with 8 local points per gate. Whether v5 degrades on MAJ-lifted instances is a conjecture; I did not trace it.

F. NOT HANDLED. Classes are syntactic. Pigeonhole cuts must remember the set of placed pigeons, and expander Tseitin cuts have 2^rank parity classes, so I conjecture bmw is exponential there for every tree, although counting or GF(2) elimination refutes them. The measured pigeonhole IALH cost (h=5 timeout) is untouched. Deciding deadness or equality of classes semantically is SAT again.
missing_theorem:
MT-A (restricted, Lean-ready, unchecked): Lemmas CELL, CONG and E and Theorem TREE as stated, with the syntactic-cofactor checker. All are short set-level arguments about clause restriction; none depends on discovery.

MT-B (open; the real gap): tree discovery. Find, in time polynomial in ||F||, a tree T with bmw(F,T)<=p(min over T' of bmw(F,T'), ||F||) for a fixed polynomial p; or prove that greedy least-mu agglomeration achieves this on a named class beyond gate-lifted formulas. mu is not symmetric in the cut, so rank-width style approximation arguments (Oum-Seymour, from memory) do not transfer directly.

MT-C (open): a class notion coarser than syntactic equality whose congruence lemma survives and whose equalities have short certificates. Candidates are equality up to an explicit signed renaming, or equality modulo the checked GF(2) quotient. Pigeonhole and incompatible linear spaces need exactly this.

Literature, from memory and unverified here: the ps-width dynamic programme of Saether, Telle and Vatshelle bounds a quantity that upper-bounds mu, and it also assumes the decomposition is given.
self_attack:
1. Neon58 is already closed by a pair-adjacent order (trusted peak 2). CELL adds order-independence and less IALH work there, not a new decision capability. The fixture is deliberately easy: it tests only that the contracted formula closes on v5 and cannot show v5 failing.
2. Fable73's link-twin contraction may coincide with CELL at |C|=2, mu=2; I cannot see its text. In that case the delta is the general class quotient, CONG, E, TREE and the MAJ test.
3. Syntactic classes are brittle. One redundant clause on one side splits a class. Comparing minimal clause sets repairs some cases but needs a two-way subsumption check in the certificate.
4. Lemma E's factor 2^e is tight for adversarial extras. Extras spread over all cells defeat every contraction; nothing is lost, but nothing is gained.
5. By analogy with pathwidth and treewidth I expect the best linear order to be within mu^O(log n) of the best tree (unproved). TREE alone is then at most a quasi-polynomial gain over ideal ordering; the practical value lies in bottom-up discovery.
6. Greedy agglomeration can be trapped by a locally cheapest merge. The cap bounds its cost, not its success.
7. The Neon58 family has n=O(log M) variables, so brute force is already polynomial in encoded size. No asymptotic separation is claimed.
8. The 65-window, 464-tuple figure depends on window ordering and on single-tuple tables passing through hull_rows as I read them; the peak-0 prediction does not.
mechanism_signature: CELL/bmw: quotient a variable cell by its syntactic cofactor classes (mu classes become ceil(log2 mu) fresh bits), certified by 2^|C| local restrictions and a section table. Classes compose as a congruence, giving a tree-shaped dynamic programme with work n*mu^2*||F|| and an extras factor 2^e. A section replaces the linear right inverse; a tree replaces the branching order.
delta_from_prior: Round 96 (CDS) branched on implied cube disjunctions, with leaves up to the product of family sizes. Round 95 (FK) needed sign-split classes. Round 94 chose linear orders. Round 89 (BVA) added variables without removing any. Fable73 contracted link-twins. New here: (i) a cofactor-class quotient for arbitrary gates, cell sizes and mu>2, with a dead class and a syntactic checker costed in literal visits; (ii) the congruence lemma and the tree work theorem, total on all CNF; (iii) the extras lemma, a fixed-parameter bound for arbitrary added clauses; (iv) the reading of the 20-variable fixture as Q18 composed with eight mixed OR/XOR gates, bypassing the linear compressor; (v) MAJ-lifting as a twin-free, kernel-free test; (vi) audit notes on the post-loop budget test and on prune across differently reduced states. Not repeated: cache key, undistribution lemma, T94 semantics.
